page.heading: Cryptographic keys
page.description: Keys used to sign and encrypt issued licences and admin sessions.

issuer.heading: Licence configuration
issuer.label: Issuer
issuer.confirmMessage: Changing the issuer invalidates all previously issued licences. This cannot be undone.

keys.heading: Signing and encryption keys
keys.publicKeyDescription: Used by client applications (beanguard-client) to verify the signature of a licence issued by this server — confirms the licence is authentic and unmodified.
keys.privateKeyDescription: Used only by this server to sign issued licences (JWS, RS256 algorithm). Never leaves the server.
keys.secretKeyDescription: Encrypts the signed licence (JWE, AES-256-GCM), so its contents are only readable by the server and the authorized client application.

regenerateModal.confirmWarning: This irreversibly invalidates ALL previously issued licences — client apps will no longer be able to verify or decrypt them.
regenerateModal.revealWarning: Save the secret key now — it will not be shown again.
